name: Kambi Group plc
summary: Kambi Group plc provides sports betting technology and services to the betting and gaming industry in Europe, the Americas, and internationally. The company provides Odds Feed+, Managed Trading, Sportsbook Platform, Bet Builder, Esports, and Front-End products for betting and gaming. It also offers eSports subscriptions; and front end-based development platform services. Kambi Group plc was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Birkirkara, Malta.
